meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'висеть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to depend on'.

examples.text: Соберись, экономика города зависит от тебя.

meanings.note: A fact or a person. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to know'.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Between people or groups. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ношение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'attitude, relation; (pl.) relationship' in everyday Russian.

Towards someone or something. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'ношение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'attitude, relation; (pl.) relationship' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'мощь'). Common feminine noun meaning 'help' in everyday Russian.

собираться.gloss: to intend, to be about to; to gather

meanings.en: to intend, to plan, to be going to
meanings.note: + infinitive. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'обираться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to intend, to be about to; to gather', paired with 'собраться'.
